description: React component for the 'Explore Roles' page in a Next.js frontend, implementing search, filters, and role display with interactions and backend API integration.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Main React component for the explore roles page, managing search state, filters, API calls, and rendering logic.

methods.name: fetchRoles
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch roles based on current filters and search query, updates roles state.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Triggers a search by setting hasSearched to true and calling fetchRoles.
